moments.title: Geri Halliwell-Horner's 54th Birthday & OMITB role
moments.blurb: Geri Halliwell-Horner, aka Ginger Spice, celebrates her 54th birthday today, with news breaking that Meryl Streep serenaded her on set for her role in the new London-set season of 'Only Murders In The Building'.

angles.name: Ginger Spice turns 54
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Ginger Spice, Geri Halliwell-Horner! What's your favourite Spice Girls track to celebrate?

angles.name: Meryl Streep serenade
angles.copy: Imagine Meryl Streep singing 'Happy Birthday' to you! That's how Geri Halliwell-Horner celebrated turning 54, on set for 'Only Murders In The Building'. Best. Birthday. Ever?

moments.title: Cowes Week 200th Anniversary Finale
moments.blurb: The 200th anniversary edition of Cowes Week, one of the world's biggest sailing events, concludes today on the Isle of Wight after a week of racing and celebrations.

angles.name: Cowes Week wraps up
angles.copy: Fair winds and following seas! Cowes Week wraps up today on the Isle of Wight after a spectacular 200th anniversary celebration. Who caught the action?

angles.name: Sailing spectacle
angles.copy: The Solent has been buzzing all week! Cowes Week 2026, celebrating 200 years, comes to a close. What a sailing spectacle!

moments.title: Official UK Singles Chart Update & New Music Friday
moments.blurb: The Official UK Singles Chart for the week ending August 6, 2026, sees 'Rein Me In' by Sam Fender and Olivia Dean at Number 1. Today is also New Music Friday, with new releases including a big collab from Madonna & Kylie.

angles.name: New Chart Topper
angles.copy: It's official! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold the Number 1 spot on the UK Singles Chart with 'Rein Me In'. What's your top track this weekend?

angles.name: New Music Friday
angles.copy: New Music Friday! Fresh tracks dropping today, including a big collab from Madonna & Kylie. What are you listening to first?

moments.title: Perseid Meteor Shower Peaks Next Week
moments.blurb: The annual Perseid meteor shower, one of the most spectacular celestial events, is expected to peak around mid-August, offering prime stargazing opportunities in the UK.

angles.name: Stargazing Alert
angles.copy: Look up next week! The Perseid meteor shower, one of the year's best, is set to peak around mid-August. Get ready for some celestial fireworks!

angles.name: Summer Night Sky
angles.copy: Clear skies mean prime viewing for the Perseids! This stunning meteor shower is almost here. Where's your favourite spot to watch the stars?

moments.title: Edinburgh Festival Fringe in Full Swing
moments.blurb: The world's largest arts festival, the Edinburgh Festival Fringe, is transforming Scotland's capital throughout August with thousands of performances across theatre, comedy, music, and more.

angles.name: Fringe is buzzing
angles.copy: Edinburgh is alive with the sound of creativity! The Fringe Festival is in full swing, bringing incredible theatre, comedy, and music to the streets of Scotland's capital.

angles.name: Catch a show
angles.copy: From stand-up to street theatre, there's something for everyone at the Edinburgh Fringe this August. What's on your must-see list?

moments.title: Edinburgh International Book Festival Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The Edinburgh International Book Festival begins on August 15th, bringing a packed programme of author events, workshops, and debates to the Scottish capital.

angles.name: Bookworms Unite
angles.copy: Get ready, book lovers! The Edinburgh International Book Festival starts next week, featuring a stellar line-up of authors and events. Who are you hoping to see?

angles.name: Literary Edinburgh
angles.copy: Beyond the Fringe, Edinburgh's literary scene comes alive with the International Book Festival from August 15th. Time to dive into some new stories!

moments.title: Community Shield Final in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The FA Community Shield 2026, featuring Premier League champions Arsenal and FA Cup holders Manchester City, will take place on Sunday, August 16th, at Principality Stadium in Cardiff.

angles.name: First silverware up for grabs
angles.copy: The first major silverware of the English football season is up for grabs! Arsenal take on Man City in the Community Shield this Sunday in Cardiff. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Cardiff hosts big game
angles.copy: Cardiff's Principality Stadium hosts a huge clash this Sunday as Arsenal meet Man City in the Community Shield. Get ready for some top-tier football!

moments.title: Madonna's 68th Birthday
moments.blurb: The iconic Queen of Pop, Madonna, will celebrate her 68th birthday on Monday, August 16th.

angles.name: Queen of Pop's Birthday
angles.copy: All hail the Queen of Pop! Madonna celebrates her 68th birthday on Monday. What's your all-time favourite track from the Material Girl?

angles.name: Celebrating an icon
angles.copy: From 'Like A Virgin' to 'Vogue', Madonna has consistently reinvented pop music. Wishing an early Happy 68th Birthday to a true icon!

moments.title: Premier League Season 2026/27 Anticipation
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season kicks off on Friday, August 21st, with defending champions Arsenal and newly promoted Coventry City, Ipswich Town, and Hull City preparing for action.

angles.name: Premier League countdown
angles.copy: The countdown is on! The Premier League returns on August 21st. Are you ready for another season of thrills, spills, and dramatic finishes?

angles.name: New season excitement
angles.copy: Who are you backing for the title this season? With Arsenal defending and new teams like Coventry City joining, the 2026/27 Premier League promises excitement!

moments.title: Green Man Festival Approaching
moments.blurb: Wales' beloved Green Man Festival, a celebration of music, arts, and culture, is set to welcome 25,000 festival-goers to the Brecon Beacons from August 20th-23rd.

angles.name: Green Man is almost here
angles.copy: The mountains are calling! Green Man Festival kicks off in the Brecon Beacons from August 20th. Who's got their tickets for a weekend of music and magic?

angles.name: Wales' festival highlight
angles.copy: More than just music, Green Man Festival is a true Welsh cultural highlight. Get ready for arts, good food, and great vibes in Powys!

moments.title: UK Summer School Holidays Continue
moments.blurb: School summer holidays are in full swing across England and Wales, with many families enjoying breaks before schools begin to return from mid-August in Scotland and early September elsewhere.

angles.name: Summer break vibes
angles.copy: Summer holidays are still on! Whether you're staycationing or jetting off, hope you're making the most of the sunshine and free time.

angles.name: Family fun in the sun
angles.copy: Keeping the kids entertained this summer? Share your top tips for family fun during the school holidays!
